# tabiji.ai

> Free AI-curated travel data API — Reddit-sourced restaurant picks, day-by-day itineraries, destination guides, and trending travel data for 6498 destinations. No API key required.

## API Documentation
- [API Docs](https://tabiji.ai/api/): Full endpoint documentation with examples
- [OpenAPI Spec](https://tabiji.ai/api/openapi.json): Machine-readable API specification (OpenAPI 3.1)
- [agents.json](https://tabiji.ai/.well-known/agents.json): AI agent workflow definitions (OpenAgents format)
- [agent.json](https://tabiji.ai/.well-known/agent.json): A2A Agent Card (Google A2A Protocol v1.0.0)

## Endpoints

### Destinations
- [All Destinations](https://tabiji.ai/api/v1/destinations.json): 6498 destinations with budget, season, vibes, travel styles, and pitch
- [Single Destination](https://tabiji.ai/api/v1/destinations/{slug}.json): Full details for one destination (e.g., `tokyo.json`, `paris.json`)

### Popular Picks (Restaurant & Attraction Guides)
- [All Picks](https://tabiji.ai/api/v1/picks.json): 876 curated "best of" guides covering 9,407 places, each linking to its canonical HTML page
- Single Picks Guide (HTML canonical): `https://tabiji.ai/popular-picks/{slug}/` — full guide with all places, editorial summaries, Reddit quotes, and insider tips (e.g., `amsterdam-brunch`, `tokyo-ramen`). Per-slug JSON was retired on 2026-04-20.

### Itineraries
- [All Itineraries](https://tabiji.ai/api/v1/itineraries.json): 399 day-by-day travel itineraries
- [Single Itinerary](https://tabiji.ai/api/v1/itineraries/{slug}.json): Full itinerary with day-by-day activities, times, tips, and logistics

### Comparisons
- [All Comparisons](https://tabiji.ai/api/v1/compare.json): 854 head-to-head destination comparisons, each linking to its canonical HTML page
- Single Comparison (HTML canonical): `https://tabiji.ai/compare/{slug}/` — full comparison with categories, Reddit quotes, verdict, and FAQs (e.g., `tokyo-vs-kyoto`). Per-slug JSON was retired on 2026-04-20.

### Countries
- [All Countries](https://tabiji.ai/api/v1/countries.json): 250 countries with capitals, population, area, region, borders, currencies, languages, timezones, driving side, dial codes, flags, and maps links
- [Single Country](https://tabiji.ai/api/v1/countries/{iso2}.json): Facts for one country by lowercase ISO code (e.g., `jp.json`, `fr.json`, `us.json`)

### Travel Health
- [All Health Records](https://tabiji.ai/api/v1/health.json): Country health guides, US insurance carrier guides, and tier-1 medication guides — each country includes healthcare quality (1–5 stars), water safety, insurance/yellow-fever flags, emergency number, pharmacy access, banned + restricted medications. `insuranceCarriers[]` and `tier1Medications[]` arrays provide per-carrier and per-medication metadata.
- Per-country health pages (HTML): `https://tabiji.ai/health/{slug}/` — hospitals with phones, local-language pharmacy phrases, medication legal status, cash prices, evacuation costs, mental-health crisis lines, vaccination lists.
- Per-carrier pages (HTML): `https://tabiji.ai/health/insurance/{slug}/` — claim walkthroughs, cost scenarios, FAQs (BCBS, UHC, Aetna, Cigna, Kaiser, Humana, Anthem, etc.).
- Per-medication pages (HTML): `https://tabiji.ai/health/medications/{slug}/` — banned/restricted country lists, travel strategy, FAQ (`adderall`, `sudafed`, `codeine`, `cbd`, `tramadol`, `xanax`, `opioids`).
- **Not personal medical or legal advice** — verify safety-critical decisions with a clinician and controlled-substance rules with the destination's embassy before flying.

### Cross-Collection Search
- [Unified Search](https://tabiji.ai/api/v1/search.json?q=tokyo): Search destinations, picks, itineraries, and comparisons from one endpoint (`q`, optional `type`, optional `limit`)

## Paid Agent Briefs (x402)

Hosted, deterministic scam and safety briefs synthesized from the free Tabiji corpus. Charged per request in USDC on Base via the [x402 protocol](https://x402.org). The free API above is unaffected.

- [x402 Meta](https://x402.tabiji.ai/v1/meta): Service catalog, pricing, payTo address, source corpus counts, and sample request
- [Agentic Market listing](https://agentic.market/?service=x402-tabiji-ai)
- Network: `eip155:8453` (Base) · USDC contract `0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913` · payTo `0x59959450bb3DA79A8bC07CC078696D6CBA3bEB4a`

### Paid endpoints
- `POST https://x402.tabiji.ai/v1/scam-brief` — destination tourist-scam brief ($0.05 / 50000 USDC atomic units)
- `POST https://x402.tabiji.ai/v1/safety-brief` — destination/country safety + advisory brief ($0.05 / 50000 USDC atomic units)
- `POST https://x402.tabiji.ai/v1/travel-risk-brief` — combined scam + safety + alerts + practical risk brief ($0.10 / 100000 USDC atomic units)

Request body shape: `{ "destination": "Barcelona", "travelerProfile": "US first-time visitor age 45+", "includeAlerts": true, "format": "agent_brief" }`. Each response includes `sourceUrls` linking back to the free `https://tabiji.ai/api/v1/*` corpus so agents can verify or expand on the brief.

## Data Fields

### Place Object (in Picks)
Each place includes: name, position, tags, googleRating, reviewCount, priceRange, address, area, googleMapsUrl, mapsLinks, openingHours (weekly grid), phone, website, photo, verdict, editorialSummary, bestFor, comparison, whatToOrder, redditQuotes (with source + sourceUrl), insiderTip, sourceMeta

### Itinerary Day Object
Each day includes: dayLabel, neighborhoods, title, description, activities (with time, name, description, details, tips)

### Destination Object
Each destination includes: slug, name, region, continent, country, countryCode, currency (code/name/symbol), language, languages, coordinates (lat/lng), photo, pitch, budget ($–$$$$), season, vibes (array), travelStyles (array), editorialSummary, bestFor, relatedPicks, relatedItineraries, relatedComparisons, relatedDestinations, sourceMeta, flag, timezone, drivingSide, dialCode, tapWaterSafe, tippingCustom, visaNote

### Country Object
Each country includes: id, name, officialName, iso2, iso3, capital, population, area (km²), region, subregion, borders (ISO3 codes), landlocked, demonyms, startOfWeek, maps, currencies, languages, timezones, flag (emoji), flagSvg, flagPng, drivingSide, dialCode, tld

### Country Health Object (in `/api/v1/health.json`)
Each country health record includes: slug, name, flag, region, url, iso2, healthcareQuality (1–5 int), healthcareQualityLabel, waterSafety (safe/caution/unsafe/unknown), emergencyNumber, healthcareSystem, pharmacyAccess, insuranceRequired (bool), yellowFeverRequired (bool), strictMedications (bool), bannedMedications (array, up to 10), restrictedMedications (array, up to 10), lastUpdated

## What Makes This Data Unique
Unlike generic travel APIs, tabiji data is curated from real traveler discussions plus Tabiji editorial judgment, then cross-linked across destinations, picks, itineraries, and comparisons. Records now expose provenance/freshness metadata and lighter-weight enrichment fields so agents can traverse the graph instead of scraping pages.

## Usage
No authentication required. All endpoints return static JSON files served via Cloudflare CDN. CORS is permissive — call from any origin. Free for non-commercial use.
